lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are organized in a structured 2D array posterior to the branchial region, featuring at least four distinct horizontal rows of approximately five to six visible nodes each.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, particularly visible in the mid-flank region, creating a discernible grid-like appearance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light above and shadow below, extending from the branchial area towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: There is a notable transition from high-density, small-diameter clusters on the cephalic region to larger, more regularly spaced circular high-luminance blobs on the lateral flank.
